verdict.rationale: Cursor documents running many agents in parallel: cloud agents in isolated VMs, and worktrees that give each agent its own isolated checkout so "several agents" can work on the same repo without conflicts. Each attempt yields reviewable output such as PRs and screenshot/video artifacts, so a developer can compare them by hand. The evidence never describes launching multiple attempts at the same task and comparing or selecting a winner side by side, so the compare-and-choose half is only implied. Missing for 10: a documented multi-attempt / best-of-N workflow for one task, a side-by-side comparison or selection UI, and independent hands-on corroboration.
